Notice of Annual General Meeting
for the year ended 31 December 2011

column1:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Fourty First Annual General Meeting of the Company will be held at Eka Hotel along Mombasa
Road,Nairobi on 21st September 2012 at 11.00 a.m. to transact the following business:
1. To table the proxies and to note the presence of a quorum.
2. To read the notice convening the meeting.
3. To confirm the minutes of the Fourtieth Annual General Meeting held on 5th August 2011.
4. To receive and consider the Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2011 together with the Chairman’s
Statement and the reports of the Directors and Auditors thereon.
5. To note that the Directors do not recommend payment of a dividend (2010: nil) in respect of the financial year ended 31
December 2011.
6. To approve the Directors’ fees as indicated in the Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2011.
7. To re-elect Directors:-
Mr. Pinhas Moscovich retires in accordance with Article 113 of the Company’s Articles of Association and, being eligible,
offers himself for re-election.
8. To reappoint Messrs. PKF Kenya, as the Company’s Auditors until the conclusion of the next Annual General Meeting of the
Company and to authorise the Directors to fix their remuneration.
SPECIAL BUSINESS
9. To discuss the future of the Company vis-a-vis the current business position.
10. INCREASE OF AUTHORISED SHARE CAPITAL
To consider and if approved, pass the following ordinary resolutions;
That the authorized share capital of the company be increased from Kshs. 216,000,000/- divided into 43,200,000 ordinary
shares of Kshs 5/- each, to Kshs. 1,250,000,000/- divided into 250,000,000 ordinary shares of Kshs 5/- each by the creation of
an additional 206,800,000 ordinary shares of Kshs 5/- each, such shares shall rank pari passu in all respects with the existing
43,200,000 ordinary shares of the company.
11. RIGHTS ISSUE
That subject to the passing of the above resolution and obtaining of the necessary regulatory approvals, the paid up share
capital of the company be increased from Kshs. 177,018,950/- to Kshs. 1,239,132,650/- by way of rights issue of 6 shares for
every 1 share held to the existing members of the company. The date of the closure of the register of members for the rights
issue and the transaction time table to be published by the directors. The shares will be offered at a nominal value of Kshs.
5/- each.
That the rights issue is not subject to a minimum subscription level and that any rights not taken up shall be offered on terms
and conditions as are determined by the Directors and notified to the shareholders through the press.
12. To transact any other business of the Annual General Meeting of which due notice has been received.
BY ORDER OF THE BOARD
EQUATORIAL SECRETARIES AND REGISTRARS
SECRETARIES
Date: 15TH AUGUST 2012
Note: A member entitled to attend and vote at the above meeting is entitled to appoint one or more proxies to attend and vote
on his or her behalf. A proxy need not be a member. To be valid, a form of proxy which is attached to this notice must be
duly completed and signed by the member and must either be lodged at the Registered office of the Company, Express
House, Road A, off Enterprise Road, P O Box 40433-00100, Nairobi or with the Company Secretaries, Equatorial Secretaries
and Registrars, Kalamu House, Grevillea Grove, off Brookside Drive, Westlands, Nairobi P O Box 47323, 00100-Nairobi, so as
to reach not later than 11.00 a.m. on 19th September 2012.
The annual report for the year ended 31st December 2011 and a form of proxy have been uploaded on our website:
www.expresskenya.com
